passages.text: Some time later, Naboth the Jezreelite happened to own a vineyard in Jezreel next to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.
passages.sermon:
Naboth was a Jezreelite.
He owned a vineyard.
The vineyard was in Jezreel.
Ahab was king of Samaria.
Ahab had a palace in Jezreel.
Naboth’s vineyard was next to Ahab’s palace.
This happened some time after the previous events.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י אַחַר֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה כֶּ֧רֶם הָיָ֛ה לְנָב֥וֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּיִזְרְעֶ֑אל אֵ֚צֶל הֵיכַ֣ל אַחְאָ֔ב מֶ֖לֶךְ שֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃

passages.text: So Ahab said to Naboth, “Give me your vineyard to use as a vegetable garden, since it is next to my palace. I will give you a better vineyard in its place—or if you prefer, I will give you its value in silver.”
passages.sermon:
Ahab was the king of Samaria.
Naboth was a Jezreelite who owned a vineyard in Jezreel.
Ahab spoke to Naboth.
Ahab said, “Give me your vineyard.
I want to use it as a vegetable garden.
Your vineyard is next to my palace.
I will give you a better vineyard instead.
If you prefer, I will give you its value in silver.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אַחְאָ֣ב אֶל־ נָב֣וֹת׀ לֵאמֹר֩׀ תְּנָה־ לִּ֨י אֶֽת־ כַּרְמְךָ֜ וִֽיהִי־ לִ֣י לְגַן־ יָרָ֗ק כִּ֣י ה֤וּא קָרוֹב֙ אֵ֣צֶל בֵּיתִ֔י וְאֶתְּנָ֤ה לְךָ֙ תַּחְתָּ֔יו כֶּ֖רֶם ט֣וֹב מִמֶּ֑נּוּ אִ֚ם ט֣וֹב בְּעֵינֶ֔יךָ אֶתְּנָה־ לְךָ֥ כֶ֖סֶף מְחִ֥יר זֶֽה׃

passages.text: But Naboth replied, “The LORD forbid that I should give you the inheritance of my fathers.”
passages.sermon:
Naboth was a Jezreelite.
He owned a vineyard in Jezreel.
Ahab was king of Samaria.
Ahab wanted Naboth’s vineyard.
Ahab asked Naboth to give him the vineyard.
Naboth answered Ahab.
Naboth said, “The LORD forbids me to give you my fathers’ inheritance.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר נָב֖וֹת אֶל־ אַחְאָ֑ב חָלִ֤ילָה לִּי֙ מֵֽיהוָ֔ה מִתִּתִּ֛י אֶת־ נַחֲלַ֥ת אֲבֹתַ֖י לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: So Ahab went to his palace, sullen and angry because Naboth the Jezreelite had told him, “I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers.” He lay down on his bed, turned his face away, and refused to eat.
passages.sermon:
Ahab was the king of Israel.
Ahab went to his palace.
Ahab felt sullen and angry.
Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to Ahab.
Naboth said, “I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers.”
Ahab lay down on his bed.
Ahab turned his face away.
Ahab refused to eat.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹא֩ אַחְאָ֨ב אֶל־ בֵּית֜וֹ סַ֣ר וְזָעֵ֗ף עַל־ הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֣ר אֵלָ֗יו נָבוֹת֙ הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִ֔י וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לֹֽא־ אֶתֵּ֥ן לְךָ֖ אֶת־ נַחֲלַ֣ת אֲבוֹתָ֑י וַיִּשְׁכַּב֙ עַל־ מִטָּת֔וֹ וַיַּסֵּ֥ב אֶת־ פָּנָ֖יו וְלֹֽא־ אָ֥כַל לָֽחֶם׃

passages.text: Soon his wife Jezebel came in and asked, “Why are you so sullen that you refuse to eat?”
passages.sermon:
Ahab was the king of Israel.
Jezebel was Ahab’s wife.
Jezebel came to Ahab.
She saw that Ahab was upset.
She saw that Ahab was not eating.
Jezebel spoke to Ahab.
She asked, “Why are you so upset?”
She asked, “Why do you refuse to eat?”
passages.original: וַתָּבֹ֥א אֵלָ֖יו אִיזֶ֣בֶל אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וַתְּדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלָ֗יו מַה־ זֶּה֙ רוּחֲךָ֣ סָרָ֔ה וְאֵינְךָ֖ אֹכֵ֥ל לָֽחֶם׃

passages.text: Ahab answered, “Because I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite and told him, ‘Give me your vineyard for silver, or if you wish, I will give you another vineyard in its place.’ And he replied, ‘I will not give you my vineyard!’ ”
passages.sermon:
Ahab was the king of Israel.
Ahab spoke to his wife Jezebel.
Ahab explained what happened with Naboth the Jezreelite.
Ahab said, “I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite.”
Ahab said, “I told him, ‘Give me your vineyard for silver.’”
Ahab said, “I also told him, ‘If you prefer, I will give you another vineyard instead.’”
Ahab said, “Naboth answered me.”
Ahab said, “Naboth said, ‘I will not give you my vineyard.’”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֶ֗יהָ כִּֽי־ אֲ֠דַבֵּר אֶל־ נָב֨וֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִ֜י וָאֹ֣מַר ל֗וֹ תְּנָה־ לִּ֤י אֶֽת־ כַּרְמְךָ֙ בְּכֶ֔סֶף א֚וֹ אִם־ חָפֵ֣ץ אַתָּ֔ה אֶתְּנָה־ לְךָ֥ כֶ֖רֶם תַּחְתָּ֑יו וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לֹֽא־ אֶתֵּ֥ן לְךָ֖ אֶת־ כַּרְמִֽי׃

passages.text: But his wife Jezebel said to him, “Do you not reign over Israel? Get up, eat some food, and be cheerful, for I will get you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.”
passages.sermon:
Jezebel was Ahab’s wife.
Jezebel spoke to Ahab.
Jezebel said, “You are the king over Israel now.
Get up.
Eat some food.
Let your heart be glad.
I will give you Naboth the Jezreelite’s vineyard.”
passages.original: וַתֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ אִיזֶ֣בֶל אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ אַתָּ֕ה עַתָּ֛ה תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה מְלוּכָ֖ה עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל ק֤וּם אֱכָל־ לֶ֙חֶם֙ וְיִטַ֣ב לִבֶּ֔ךָ אֲנִי֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן לְךָ֔ אֶת־ כֶּ֖רֶם נָב֥וֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִֽי׃

passages.text: Then Jezebel wrote letters in Ahab’s name, sealed them with his seal, and sent them to the elders and nobles who lived with Naboth in his city.
passages.sermon:
Jezebel was Ahab’s wife.
Jezebel wrote letters.
She wrote the letters using Ahab’s name.
She sealed the letters with Ahab’s seal.
She sent the letters to the elders and nobles.
These elders and nobles lived in Naboth’s city.
passages.original: וַתִּכְתֹּ֤ב סְפָרִים֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם אַחְאָ֔ב וַתַּחְתֹּ֖ם בְּחֹתָמ֑וֹ וַתִּשְׁלַ֣ח הַסְפָרִים אֶל־ הַזְקֵנִ֤ים וְאֶל־ הַֽחֹרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּעִיר֔וֹ הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים אֶת־ נָבֽוֹת׃

passages.text: In the letters she wrote: “Proclaim a fast and give Naboth a seat of honor among the people.
passages.sermon:
Jezebel was the wife of King Ahab of Israel.
Jezebel wrote letters to the elders and nobles in Naboth’s city.
She wrote instructions in the letters.
She told them to proclaim a fast.
She told them to give Naboth a seat of honor among the people.
passages.original: וַתִּכְתֹּ֥ב בַּסְּפָרִ֖ים לֵאמֹ֑ר קִֽרְאוּ־ צ֔וֹם וְהוֹשִׁ֥יבוּ אֶת־ נָב֖וֹת בְּרֹ֥אשׁ הָעָֽם׃

passages.text: But seat two scoundrels opposite him and have them testify, ‘You have cursed both God and the king!’ Then take him out and stone him to death.”
passages.sermon:
Jezebel was the queen and wife of King Ahab.
She wanted to harm Naboth.
She gave instructions in a letter.
She said, “Seat two wicked men across from Naboth.”
These men must be scoundrels.
They must accuse Naboth.
They must say, ‘You have cursed God and the king.’
After this, take Naboth outside the city.
Stone Naboth to death.
passages.original: וְ֠הוֹשִׁיבוּ שְׁנַ֨יִם אֲנָשִׁ֥ים בְּנֵֽי־ בְלִיַּעַל֮ נֶגְדּוֹ֒ וִיעִדֻ֣הוּ לֵאמֹ֔ר בֵּרַ֥כְתָּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים וָמֶ֑לֶךְ וְהוֹצִיאֻ֥הוּ וְסִקְלֻ֖הוּ וְיָמֹֽת׃

passages.text: So the elders and nobles who lived in Naboth’s city did as Jezebel had instructed in the letters she had written to them.
passages.sermon:
The elders and nobles lived in Naboth’s city.
Jezebel sent them letters.
She gave them instructions in the letters.
The elders and nobles did what Jezebel told them.
They followed everything written in her letters.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ֩ אַנְשֵׁ֨י עִיר֜וֹ הַזְּקֵנִ֣ים וְהַחֹרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר הַיֹּֽשְׁבִים֙ בְּעִיר֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר שָׁלְחָ֥ה אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם אִיזָ֑בֶל כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר כָּתוּב֙ בַּסְּפָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁלְחָ֖ה אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: They proclaimed a fast and gave Naboth a seat of honor among the people.
passages.sermon:
The elders and nobles lived in Naboth’s city.
Jezebel sent them letters with instructions.
The elders and nobles obeyed Jezebel’s instructions.
They announced a fast to the people.
They gave Naboth a seat at the head of the assembly.
Naboth sat in a place of honor among the people.
passages.original: קָרְא֖וּ צ֑וֹם וְהֹשִׁ֥יבוּ אֶת־ נָב֖וֹת בְּרֹ֥אשׁ הָעָֽם׃

passages.text: And the two scoundrels came in and sat opposite Naboth, and these men testified against him before the people, saying, “Naboth has cursed both God and the king!” So they took him outside the city and stoned him to death.
passages.sermon:
Two wicked men entered.
These men were called sons of Belial.
They sat across from Naboth.
These wicked men testified against Naboth.
They spoke before all the people.
They said, “Naboth has cursed God and the king.”
The people took Naboth outside the city.
They stoned Naboth with stones.
Naboth died.
passages.original: וַ֠יָּבֹאוּ שְׁנֵ֨י הָאֲנָשִׁ֥ים בְּנֵֽי־ בְלִיַּעַל֮ וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ נֶגְדּוֹ֒ וַיְעִדֻהוּ֩ אַנְשֵׁ֨י הַבְּלִיַּ֜עַל אֶת־ נָב֗וֹת נֶ֤גֶד הָעָם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בֵּרַ֥ךְ נָב֛וֹת אֱלֹהִ֖ים וָמֶ֑לֶךְ וַיֹּצִאֻ֙הוּ֙ מִח֣וּץ לָעִ֔יר וַיִּסְקְלֻ֥הוּ בָאֲבָנִ֖ים וַיָּמֹֽת׃

passages.text: Then they sent word to Jezebel: “Naboth has been stoned to death.”
passages.sermon:
Jezebel was the queen.
The people sent a message to Jezebel.
They told her about Naboth.
They said, “Naboth has been stoned.”
They said, “Naboth is dead.”
passages.original: וַֽיִּשְׁלְח֖וּ אֶל־ אִיזֶ֣בֶל לֵאמֹ֑ר סֻקַּ֥ל נָב֖וֹת וַיָּמֹֽת׃

passages.text: When Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned to death, she said to Ahab, “Get up and take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, who refused to give it to you for silver. For Naboth is no longer alive, but dead.”
passages.sermon:
Jezebel was the wife of Ahab, king of Israel.
Jezebel heard that Naboth was dead.
People had stoned Naboth to death.
Jezebel spoke to Ahab.
She said, “Get up and take the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.”
Naboth had refused to give his vineyard to Ahab for money.
Jezebel said, “Naboth is not alive.”
She said, “Naboth is dead.”
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ כִּשְׁמֹ֣עַ אִיזֶ֔בֶל כִּֽי־ סֻקַּ֥ל נָב֖וֹת וַיָּמֹ֑ת וַתֹּ֨אמֶר אִיזֶ֜בֶל אֶל־ אַחְאָ֗ב ק֣וּם רֵ֞שׁ אֶת־ כֶּ֣רֶם׀ נָב֣וֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִ֗י אֲשֶׁ֤ר מֵאֵן֙ לָתֶת־ לְךָ֣ בְכֶ֔סֶף כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין נָב֛וֹת חַ֖י כִּי־ מֵֽת׃

passages.text: And when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, he got up and went down to take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.
passages.sermon:
Ahab was the king of Israel.
Ahab heard that Naboth was dead.
Naboth was a Jezreelite.
Ahab got up.
Ahab went down to the vineyard of Naboth.
Ahab went to take possession of the vineyard.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֛י כִּשְׁמֹ֥עַ אַחְאָ֖ב כִּ֣י מֵ֣ת נָב֑וֹת וַיָּ֣קָם אַחְאָ֗ב לָרֶ֛דֶת אֶל־ כֶּ֛רֶם נָב֥וֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִ֖י לְרִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: Then the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying, “Get up and go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who is in Samaria. See, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, of which he has gone to take possession.
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet from Tishbe.
The LORD spoke to Elijah.
The LORD gave Elijah a command.
The LORD said, "Get up."
The LORD said, "Go down."
The LORD told Elijah to meet Ahab.
Ahab was the king of Israel.
Ahab lived in Samaria.
Ahab was now in the vineyard of Naboth.
Ahab went there to take possession of the vineyard.
passages.original: וַיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ אֵלִיָּ֥הוּ הַתִּשְׁבִּ֖י לֵאמֹֽר׃ ק֣וּם רֵ֗ד לִקְרַ֛את אַחְאָ֥ב מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּשֹׁמְר֑וֹן הִנֵּה֙ בְּכֶ֣רֶם נָב֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר־ יָ֥רַד שָׁ֖ם לְרִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Tell him that this is what the LORD says: ‘Have you not murdered a man and seized his land?’ Then tell him that this is also what the LORD says: ‘In the place where the dogs licked up the blood of Naboth, there also the dogs will lick up your blood—yes, yours!’”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Elijah the Tishbite.
The LORD told Elijah to speak to Ahab, king of Israel.
Ahab killed Naboth and took Naboth’s vineyard.
Elijah must say to Ahab, “This is what the LORD says.”
“You have murdered a man.”
“You have also taken his land.”
Elijah must say again, “This is what the LORD says.”
“In the place where dogs licked Naboth’s blood, dogs will lick your blood.”
“Yes, dogs will lick your blood, Ahab.”
passages.original: וְדִבַּרְתָּ֨ אֵלָ֜יו לֵאמֹ֗ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הֲרָצַ֖חְתָּ וְגַם־ יָרָ֑שְׁתָּ וְדִבַּרְתָּ֨ אֵלָ֜יו לֵאמֹ֗ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה בִּמְק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר לָקְק֤וּ הַכְּלָבִים֙ אֶת־ דַּ֣ם נָב֔וֹת יָלֹ֧קּוּ הַכְּלָבִ֛ים אֶת־ דָּמְךָ֖ גַּם־ אָֽתָּה׃

passages.text: When Elijah arrived, Ahab said to him, “So you have found me out, my enemy.” He replied, “I have found you out because you have sold yourself to do evil in the sight of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Ahab was the king of Israel.
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
Ahab saw Elijah.
Ahab spoke to Elijah.
Ahab said, “You have found me, my enemy.”
Elijah answered Ahab.
Elijah said, “I have found you.”
Elijah said, “You have sold yourself.”
Elijah said, “You do evil.”
Elijah said, “You do evil in the sight of the LORD.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אַחְאָב֙ אֶל־ אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ הַֽמְצָאתַ֖נִי אֹיְבִ֑י וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מָצָ֔אתִי יַ֚עַן הִתְמַכֶּרְךָ֔ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: This is what the LORD says: ‘I will bring calamity on you and consume your descendants; I will cut off from Ahab every male in Israel, both slave and free.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Ahab, king of Israel.
Ahab did evil in the sight of the LORD.
The LORD said, "I will bring disaster upon you."
I will destroy your descendants.
I will cut off every male from your family in Israel.
This includes both slave and free men.
passages.original: הִנְנִ֨י מֵבִי אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ רָעָ֔ה וּבִעַרְתִּ֖י אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ וְהִכְרַתִּ֤י לְאַחְאָב֙ מַשְׁתִּ֣ין בְּקִ֔יר וְעָצ֥וּר וְעָז֖וּב בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: I will make your house like that of Jeroboam son of Nebat and like that of Baasha son of Ahijah, because you have provoked My anger and caused Israel to sin.’
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Ahab through Elijah.
God said, “I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam son of Nebat.
I will also make your house like the house of Baasha son of Ahijah.
You have made Me angry.
You have caused Israel to sin.”
passages.original: וְנָתַתִּ֣י אֶת־ בֵּיתְךָ֗ כְּבֵית֙ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ נְבָ֔ט וּכְבֵ֖ית בַּעְשָׁ֣א בֶן־ אֲחִיָּ֑ה אֶל־ הַכַּ֙עַס֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִכְעַ֔סְתָּ וַֽתַּחֲטִ֖א אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And the LORD also speaks concerning Jezebel: ‘The dogs will devour Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.’
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke about Jezebel.
Jezebel was the wife of Ahab.
Ahab was the king of Israel.
Jezebel led Ahab to do evil.
The LORD said, “Dogs will eat Jezebel.”
This will happen by the wall of Jezreel.
passages.original: וְגַ֨ם־ לְאִיזֶ֔בֶל דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר הַכְּלָבִ֛ים יֹאכְל֥וּ אֶת־ אִיזֶ֖בֶל בְּחֵ֥ל יִזְרְעֶֽאל׃

passages.text: Anyone belonging to Ahab who dies in the city will be eaten by dogs, and anyone who dies in the field will be eaten by the birds of the air.”
passages.sermon:
Ahab was the king of Israel.
Ahab did great evil in the sight of the LORD.
Ahab led Israel into sin.
Anyone from Ahab’s family who dies in the city will be eaten by dogs.
Anyone from Ahab’s family who dies in the field will be eaten by the birds of the air.
passages.original: הַמֵּ֤ת לְאַחְאָב֙ בָּעִ֔יר יֹאכְל֖וּ הַכְּלָבִ֑ים וְהַמֵּת֙ בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה יֹאכְל֖וּ ע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

passages.text: (Surely there was never one like Ahab, who sold himself to do evil in the sight of the LORD, incited by his wife Jezebel.
passages.sermon:
Ahab was king of Israel.
Ahab did more evil than anyone before him.
Ahab chose to do what was wrong in the sight of the LORD.
Ahab gave himself completely to evil.
Jezebel was Ahab’s wife.
Jezebel urged Ahab to do evil.
No one else was like Ahab in doing evil.
Ahab let his wife Jezebel lead him into sin.
passages.original: רַ֚ק לֹֽא־ הָיָ֣ה כְאַחְאָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִתְמַכֵּ֔ר לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־ הֵסַ֥תָּה אֹת֖וֹ אִיזֶ֥בֶל אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He committed the most detestable acts by going after idols, just like the Amorites whom the LORD had driven out before the Israelites.)
passages.sermon:
Ahab was king of Israel.
Ahab did very evil things.
Ahab followed idols.
Ahab did things that God hates.
Ahab acted like the Amorites.
The Amorites also worshiped idols.
The LORD drove out the Amorites before the Israelites.
Ahab copied the sins of the Amorites.
passages.original: וַיַּתְעֵ֣ב מְאֹ֔ד לָלֶ֖כֶת אַחֲרֵ֣י הַגִּלֻּלִ֑ים כְּכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂ֣וּ הָאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁר֙ הוֹרִ֣ישׁ יְהוָ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

passages.text: When Ahab heard these words, he tore his clothes, put on sackcloth, and fasted. He lay down in sackcloth and walked around meekly.
passages.sermon:
Ahab was the king of Israel.
Ahab did much evil in the sight of the LORD.
His wife Jezebel incited him to do evil.
Ahab heard the words spoken to him.
He tore his clothes.
He put sackcloth on his body.
He fasted.
He lay down in sackcloth.
He walked around meekly.
passages.original: וַיְהִי֩ כִשְׁמֹ֨עַ אַחְאָ֜ב אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֤ים הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ וַיִּקְרַ֣ע בְּגָדָ֔יו וַיָּֽשֶׂם־ שַׂ֥ק עַל־ בְּשָׂר֖וֹ וַיָּצ֑וֹם וַיִּשְׁכַּ֣ב בַּשָּׂ֔ק וַיְהַלֵּ֖ךְ אַֽט׃ס

passages.text: Then the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying: “Have you seen how Ahab has humbled himself before Me? Because he has humbled himself before Me, I will not bring the calamity during his days, but I will bring it upon his house in the days of his son.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Elijah the Tishbite.
The LORD said, “Ahab has humbled himself before Me.
You have seen this.
Because Ahab has humbled himself before Me, I will not bring disaster in his lifetime.
I will bring disaster on his house in the days of his son.”
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ אֵלִיָּ֥הוּ הַתִּשְׁבִּ֖י לֵאמֹֽר׃ הֲ‍ֽרָאִ֔יתָ כִּֽי־ נִכְנַ֥ע אַחְאָ֖ב מִלְּפָנָ֑י יַ֜עַן כִּֽי־ נִכְנַ֣ע מִפָּנַ֗י לֹֽא־ אָבִי הָֽרָעָה֙ בְּיָמָ֔יו בִּימֵ֣י בְנ֔וֹ אָבִ֥יא הָרָעָ֖ה עַל־ בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
